title: 🤔 क्या मिष्टी बिना बाल्टी अपनी कविता का ताल पूरा कर पाएगी? #hindikids #kavita
title_alts: 😅 मिष्टी ने छत पर बाल्टी थपथपाई, पर छोटा भाई वही बाल्टी माँगने आया... #hindikids #kavita
😮 मिष्टी की बाल्टी और बीच में रुकी कविता... छत पर ताल अब कौन देगा? #hindikids #kavita
refrain: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
description_hook: छत पर कविता का ताल एक ही बाल्टी से चल रहा था। फिर वही बाल्टी छोटे भाई को चाहिए थी।

characters.name: मिष्टी
characters.description: six years old, two short braids with red bands, yellow kurta and blue shorts, a small red bindi

scenes.narration: छत पर मिष्टी को ताल देना था, वरना कविता रुक जाती। बाल्टी ही ढोल थी।
scenes.caption: Mishti had to keep the beat, or the poem stopped. The bucket was the drum.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, kneels on a flat rooftop with both palms resting on an upside-down steel bucket. Three children sit cross-legged in front of her holding open notebooks. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts stands near the parapet. Late afternoon sunlight, a washing line and two tulsi pots behind them, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी ने बाल्टी थपथपाई। धीमी सी आवाज़ आई। गिनती एक, दो, तीन। तुम भी थपथपाओ!
scenes.caption: Mishti tapped the bucket. A soft sound came. One, two, three. Tap along too!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, slaps the upside-down steel bucket with flat palms on the rooftop, her mouth open as she counts. The three seated children lean forward and one holds up three fingers. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts crouches beside the bucket. Warm low sunlight, long shadows across the roof.

scenes.narration: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: One tap, two taps, the beat is whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, chants with her chin lifted and one palm raised above the steel bucket on the rooftop. The three children clap in time. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts copies her raised hand. Golden evening light across the rooftop.

scenes.narration: छोटा भाई आया और बाल्टी माँगी। खींचातानी में बाल्टी छत के पार लुढ़की। कविता बीच में रुकी।
scenes.caption: Her little brother wanted the bucket. It rolled across the roof. The poem stopped.
scenes.image_brief: On the rooftop Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, and her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts both reach after the steel bucket, which is rolling on its side toward the far corner of the roof. The three children sit with their notebooks closed, silent. Flat grey light, a little dust in the air.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी ने बाल्टी भाई को दी। टिफ़िन की थाली, दो चम्मच उठाए। बोली, “एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!”
scenes.caption: Mishti gave her brother the bucket and picked up her tiffin plate and two spoons.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, holds a round steel tiffin plate in one hand and two spoons in the other on the rooftop. Her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts hugs the steel bucket, delighted. The three children look up from their notebooks. Warm evening light, long shadows.

scenes.narration: एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: One tap, two taps, the beat is whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, strikes the steel plate with two spoons on the rooftop, mouth open in a chant, while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts thumps the upturned bucket beside her. The three children clap along. Bright warm evening sunlight.

scenes.narration: अब भाई बाल्टी पर, मिष्टी थाली पर। धीरे से गुनगुनाओ, तुम भी।
scenes.caption: Now brother on the bucket, Mishti on the plate. Hum along, softly.
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, taps the steel plate softly with one spoon while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts pats the upturned bucket beside her on the rooftop. The three children hum with their eyes half closed. Dusk light, a pink sky behind the water tank.

scenes.narration: मिष्टी हँस पड़ी। ताल पहले से बड़ा लगा। एक थाप, दो थाप, ताल पूरा!
scenes.caption: Mishti laughed. The beat sounded bigger than before. One tap, two taps, whole!
scenes.image_brief: Mishti, a six-year-old girl with two short braids tied with red bands, a yellow kurta and blue shorts, laughs with her head tilted back and the spoons raised over the steel plate on the rooftop, while her four-year-old brother in a green vest and grey shorts drums the bucket beside her. The three children sing with their hands up. Last orange sunlight, happy mood.

title: 😳 पीहू ने बारह लाइनें जोड़ीं, पर आठवीं लाइन पर शब्द उलझ गए... #kids #kahani
title_alts: 🤔 क्या पीहू की सबसे लंबी कविता चार बच्चों की ताली पा सकेगी? #kids #kahani
😊 पीहू की लंबी पट्टी और अटकी हुई आठवीं लाइन... अब कमरे में क्या होगा? #kids #kahani
refrain: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
description_hook: पीहू चाहती थी कि उसकी कविता सबसे लंबी हो। बारह लाइनें लिखना आसान था, याद रखना नहीं।

characters.name: पीहू
characters.description: six years old, short bob with a red hairclip, orange frock, a smudge of pencil on one cheek

scenes.narration: पीहू की कविता सबसे लंबी होनी थी, वरना ताली नहीं मिलती। कमरे में चार बच्चे बैठे।
scenes.caption: Peehu's poem had to be the longest, or no one clapped. Four children sat down.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands in a small room holding a long strip of paper covered in handwritten lines. Four children sit cross-legged on a mat in front of her with their hands in their laps. Soft daylight through a window, a ceiling fan and a cot behind them, eager mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी पर बारह लाइनें लिखीं। आठवीं पर शब्द उलझे। तुम भी गिनो, आठ या नौ?
scenes.caption: Peehu had written twelve lines. The eighth tangled. Count with her: eight or nine?
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, reads from the long paper strip held at arm's length in the small room, her lips pursed in the middle of a word. Two of the four seated children hold up fingers to count, the other two fidget with the mat. Daylight from the window, the fan turning above.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her own knee with two fingers while chanting, the long paper strip tucked under one arm, standing in the small room. The four children watch her tapping hand. Bright daylight from the window.

scenes.narration: दो बच्चे उठकर बाहर चल दिए। पीहू फिर उसी लाइन पर अटकी।
scenes.caption: Two children got up and walked outside. Peehu stuck on the same line again.
scenes.image_brief: In the small room two children walk out through the doorway with their backs turned, while Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, stands with the long paper strip drooping from one hand and her mouth half open. The two children still on the mat look at the floor. Flat daylight, the window pale.

scenes.narration: पीहू ने पट्टी चार टुकड़ों में फाड़ी। हर बच्चे को एक टुकड़ा। बोली, “एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!”
scenes.caption: Peehu tore the strip into four pieces and handed one to each child.
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, holds four short torn pieces of the paper strip fanned out in one hand in the small room and passes one to each of the two children on the mat. Two empty places on the mat beside them. Daylight from the window, lively mood.

scenes.narration: एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: One tap, one line, then on we go!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, taps her knee in time in the small room while the two children hold their torn paper pieces and tap their knees the same way. Daylight from the window, warm mood.

scenes.narration: बाहर गए बच्चे लौट आए। चारों ने बारी बारी लाइन कही। तुम भी जोड़ो!
scenes.caption: The two who left came back. All four said a line in turn. Add yours too!
scenes.image_brief: Four children sit in a circle on the mat in the small room, each holding a short torn paper piece, one of them speaking with a hand raised while the others tap their knees. Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, kneels in the circle listening. Soft late daylight from the window, calm mood.

scenes.narration: पीहू को छोटी कविता बड़ी लगी। एक थपकी, एक लाइन, फिर आगे!
scenes.caption: Peehu's short poem felt bigger than the long one. One tap, one line, then on!
scenes.image_brief: Peehu, a six-year-old girl with a short bob and a red hairclip, wearing an orange frock, sits back on her heels in the small room with shining eyes and her torn paper piece pressed to her chest, the four children around her tapping their knees together. Warm late daylight from the window, contented mood.
